title: Not worth your money.
text: The pop and the tshirt that came with the Venom themed box are fine and fit well. The decal stress ball and mini dorbz pop do not do not do not make this box worthy of the 30 dollar price point. The upcoming X-Men one doesn't include a tshirt which leads me to believe it will be unworthy as well. The Marvel 10 year anniversary edition was boxed with 3 items. A Movie Moment Pop doesn't make up for that fact when its from Iron Man 2.
label: negative
